mechanism: Zoledronic acid can cause electrolyte disturbances (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and fluphenazine increases risk of QT prolongation and arrhythmias, particularly with electrolyte abnormalities; both drugs may increase CNS depression and sedation.
action: Monitor electrolytes (calcium, magnesium) regularly in patients receiving both drugs; assess QT interval; use lowest effective fluphenazine dose and consider ECG monitoring.
